evals.name: amadeus-mandatory-sections
evals.prompt:
Draft a Trello card for this issue (markdown only — do not call any Trello MCP tools). We are seeing 'NO FARE FOR CLASS' on AMADEUS BookFlight for office YYZAA38AA over the last 14 days (2026-05-18 to 2026-06-01). The search returns a fare class and we forward it unchanged, but Amadeus rejects it at pricing. Sample debug-log permalinks:
- https://reservations.voyagesalacarte.ca/debug-logs/log-group/abc123#65f1 (search response, class Q)
- https://reservations.voyagesalacarte.ca/debug-logs/log-group/abc123#65f2 (book response, rejected)
- https://reservations.voyagesalacarte.ca/debug-logs/log-group/def456#65f3

Produce the card title and the full description body (markdown).
evals.expected_output: Short concrete title `AMADEUS: <≤~10-word clause>` (no trailing qualifiers). Body uses H3 `⊙` headings (`### ⊙ **...**`) with a blank line after each heading and after each section. The three mandatory sections appear in order: Short description (ONE plain sentence, no count, no stacked acronyms), Details (flow explained with the debug-log permalinks INLINE at the step each proves, one per line; unproven cause marked `Assumption:`), Visibility (one debuggable Mongo query with leading `$match` + window; count line only if a real number is known, else omitted — never fabricated; counts only here). This is a bug card, NOT a new integration: NO `Credentials / access` section. NO `QA notes` section (no shipped fix to verify). Optional `Possible solution / expected behavior` is allowed. AI footer after a `---`, nothing after it. No bare-`⊙` or `##` headings. Content sits directly under each heading (no blank line after the heading); one blank line separates sections. Plain ESL-friendly language (e.g. 'sometimes' not 'intermittently', 'in some cases' not 'on a share of').

evals.name: respro-glossary-no-credentials
evals.prompt:
Draft a Trello card (markdown only — do not call any Trello MCP tools). On RESPRO, agents on the Voyages a la carte ResPro booking page report that creating a booking for content source Downtowntravel intermittently fails at the payment step and the booking never reaches a confirmed state. Reproducing it needs an agent login to the ResPro internal booking page on staging. We have ~30 failed attempts over the last week. Debug-log permalink sample: https://reservations.voyagesalacarte.ca/debug-logs/log-group/tx789#aa11

Produce the card title and full description body (markdown).
evals.expected_output: SHORT title, e.g. `RESPRO: Downtowntravel booking fails at payment` (no long trailing clause). H3 `⊙` headings with blank lines. Three mandatory sections in order. Uses GLOSSARY terms: 'ResPro page' (NOT 'Voyages a la carte ResPro'), 'the agent'. Short description one sentence. Details explains the agent flow on the ResPro page and payment-step failure with the permalink inline; the staging-login access note appears HERE in Details (prose), not a separate section; unproven cause marked `Assumption:`. Visibility has a debuggable query plus the ~30 count (flagged as an estimate) and window; counts only here. Because this is a bug (NOT a new integration): NO `Credentials / access` section. NO `QA notes` section. Optional `Possible solution / expected behavior` allowed. AI footer last after `---`. No fabricated login anywhere. Content sits directly under each heading (no blank line after the heading); one blank line separates sections. Plain ESL-friendly language — 'sometimes' not 'intermittently', 'in some cases' not 'on a share of attempts', 'real users on the front end are not affected' not 'does not surface on the storefront flow'.
